patterns.prevention:
• Contact centres that switched providers within the last 3 months to understand what the competing provider offered differently (pricing, scheduling flexibility, program variety).

• Audit scheduling options across all centres—prioritize offering more time slots and flexible session lengths to reduce cancellations due to timing conflicts.

• Reach out to centres expressing interest in running programs internally and present a hybrid or partnership model that addresses their cost or control concerns before they fully transition away.

• Review feedback from centres with high session completion rates (like Gabe's 51 sessions) to identify what worked and replicate those practices with at-risk accounts.
